records.quote: Recently, Humpston and Sangha [62] redetermined the composition and temperature of the eutectic reaction (E) in the Au-Sb-Si ternary system through metallographic examination and thermal analysis. The obtained temperature of the eutectic reaction (604 K) is in good agreement with the experimental value (605 K) by Legendre and Hancheng [60], while the liquid composition of the eutectic reaction (12.5 at.% Sb, 13.5 at.% Si) differ obviously from the previous experimental results (20 at.% Sb, 10 at.% Si) [60].
